claim: Per-sample CFG normalization fixes cross-batch coupling while retaining the input dtype and batch-size-one reference behavior
source_check: The author already owns issue #41705 and PR #41706 for the per-sample rewrite. The dimensioned FP32 scale differs from the original zero-dimensional multiplier; merely passing FP32 composition tests does not establish the low-precision output contract.
independent_reproduction: Standalone import of exact baseline ced5e9fe and author PR head under pinned offline Torch 2.13.0+cpu. Baseline passes supported-dtype, singleton-parity and zero-input tests. Author head fails eight FP16/BF16 subcases by returning FP32. Explicit product-dtype restoration passes all three precision tests and three existing FP32 composition tests. No repository suite or GPU/image-generation run.
evidence_scope: Public reproduction and suggestion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41706#issuecomment-5923385134 . CPU component evidence only; author acceptance and merge remain unproven. Used to revise delivery guidance, so exclude this mechanism/case from a prospective test of that guidance. No new Kimi call was made for this owner review; no causal cost or yield comparison is established.

claim: CompressedTensorsConfig.get_supported_act_dtypes needs a classmethod decorator because its receiver is named cls
source_check: The base QuantizationConfig declares an instance method; the production model loader invokes it on the configuration instance. The receiver name cls does not change Python method binding. A class-only call raising TypeError tests a contract the caller does not use.
independent_reproduction: Independent source/interface/caller review only; no package or GPU execution. Public anchors: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/2ff52e3ceb0bcfdc8ba1dd0367b39ce0370bbfaf/python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/base_config.py#L165 and https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/2ff52e3ceb0bcfdc8ba1dd0367b39ce0370bbfaf/python/sglang/srt/model_loader/loader.py#L261 .
evidence_scope: A caller-bound counterexample to this hypothesis, not proof that every quantization path is correct. Exposed during development; exclude this case from a prospective evaluation of caller-aware evidence selection. No model-quality or cost comparison is established.

claim: MiniMax NPU helper's id(forward_batch) cache can serve stale values after object-ID reuse
source_check: The production forward_extend caller keeps a strong reference to forward_batch in its outer cached tuple, checks identity before reuse, and clears both caches on metadata initialization. The old batch remains alive while the next helper result is computed. A helper-only test that drops the batch omits this ownership contract.
independent_reproduction: Independent source and cache-lifecycle review only, not an NPU run. Public ownership anchor: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/99c59a2ea62f32fd5497eceaf2ed18cad33389db/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/minimax_sparse_backend.py#L1517 .
evidence_scope: Bound to the reviewed caller and source revision; a future caller or lifetime change requires a new check. Exposed development case, not prospective holdout or a measured general false-positive reduction.
